meta.title: Marco Tenorio Cortés · Software Engineer
meta.description: Software Engineer at Minsait and solution architect on SIMPL-Open, the EU data-spaces middleware. Technical audits, REST APIs and test automation. Based in Seville.
hero.tagline: I design integration architectures and audit code at Minsait. Right now, on SIMPL-Open: the European Commission's middleware for data spaces.

about.title: From code to architecture
about.p1: I'm a Software Engineer at Minsait. I work as a solution architect on SIMPL-Open, the European Commission's data-spaces middleware, and I audit clients' Java microservices and APIs to catch security, scalability and performance issues before they reach production.
about.p2: Before that I automated banking test suites at NTT DATA, and I'm now doing my master's in Computer Engineering at Universidad de Sevilla alongside the job. I care about understanding why a tool works, not just how to use it. And that coffee is mine.

experience.title: Where I've worked
experience.minsait.summary: Development on an international project run in English, combined with technical consulting and audits for clients.
experience.minsait.b1: Solution architect on SIMPL-Open, the European Commission's data-spaces middleware: integration architecture, interoperability, security and governance requirements, and OpenAPI contracts.
experience.minsait.b2: Technical audits of clients' Java/Spring Boot microservices and APIs, with concrete recommendations on security, scalability and performance.
experience.minsait.b3: Defining and reviewing REST API contracts and development standards to keep systems consistent and maintainable.
experience.ntt.summary: Test automation for the banking sector.
experience.ntt.b1: Designed and ran automated tests with Selenium, JUnit and Cucumber, cutting testing time while meeting the financial sector's quality standards.
experience.ntt.b2: Started as a QA Tester intern at the same company before moving into the junior role.
experience.dynos.summary: Systems administration internship during my SMR vocational studies.

projects.faro.title: Faro — a copilot for Jira and Confluence
projects.faro.desc: Chrome extension that turns a local opencode server into a copilot inside Jira and Confluence: it answers, walks you to the page by unfolding the tree and highlights the exact passage.

method.title: How I work with AI
method.sdd.name: Spec-Driven Development
method.sdd.desc: Spec, contracts and non-negotiable decisions are written before the code; the model implements against them.
method.tdd.name: Tests first
method.tdd.desc: Pure logic in DOM-free modules, tested in Node; every fix with a test seen failing first.
method.review.name: Adversarial review
method.review.desc: Every milestone is reviewed by several agents with different lenses; each finding is verified and applied before the next one.
method.docs.name: Living docs
method.docs.desc: Tests check that the README and project map never drift from the code.
